public_execution_contract.platform: macOS, Python 3.14 (virtual environment). No other platform is claimed.
public_execution_contract.network: Required only for pip install and setup-model (one embedding model, cached in .hf_home/). The run step is offline: Hugging Face offline mode and ANAXI's network guard.
public_execution_contract.reproducible: Every publicly bound owner-inventory scenario (offline bound tests plus synthetic public-resource artifacts, exact N==M), the offline reference harness, and byte-identical regeneration of the synthetic fixtures and their assay evidence.
not_reproducible: live-only requirements (need genuine live occasions; no live evidence ships)
two production-only scenarios, omitted from the public bindings (NOT_ATTEMPTED)
the Windows launcher node (outside the macOS-only contract)
owner live dispositions recorded in production acceptance (not published raw)
optional real-model harnesses (need a local Ollama model; probabilistic; skipped by default)

outside_the_public_command.note: The public run executes exactly the bound test nodes (scenario_evidence.py) plus the reference harness; it does not run the whole historical suite. Unbound tests that read excluded raw production evidence ship unchanged but are not part of the public command.

claude_agent.py.reason: Imported by the pinned custom-runner suite test_bounded_hippocampus_integration.py, whose runner node is bound in two public scenarios (Claude fail-closed guard); A1 had classed it obsolete. Its tests use a poison key and never reach a network or credential.

unbound_tests_reading_excluded_productio.note: The public run executes exactly the bound test nodes (scenario_evidence.py) plus the reference harness; it does not run the whole historical suite. Unbound tests that read excluded raw production evidence ship unchanged but are not part of the public command.
